text:
maria_sales: Hey team — ACME trial is blocked. They get a 403 when calling embeddings and chat. Sales meeting in 30m, can we triage quickly? :grimacing:

sam_backend: Can you paste the failing curl and response? 403 could be org binding or scopes.

maria_sales: Posted below (redacted key). They say it worked yesterday.

maria_sales: ```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings 
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk_trial_XXXX' 
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' 
  -H 'X-Redwood-Org: acme-corp' 
  -d '{"model":"tiny-embed-1","input":"hello"}'

HTTP/1.1 403 Forbidden
{
  "error": {
    "code": "org_mismatch",
    "message": "API key org does not match X-Redwood-Org header or request tenant"
  }
}
```

nina_sre: org_mismatch. Two quick checks: 1) confirm key binding with our key-check endpoint, 2) check if they swapped a project/tenant header in their infra.

sam_backend: Agreed. Maria, can you ask them to call the key inspect endpoint and paste result (redact secrets):

```
curl -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk_trial_XXXX' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/keys/inspect
```

That returns the key->org and scopes.

maria_sales: They returned: ```{ "key_id":"sk_trial_XXXX","org":"acme-qa","scopes":["chat:write","embeddings:read"],"status":"active" }```

sam_backend: Aha — key is bound to "acme-qa" but their header is "acme-corp". If they pass an explicit X-Redwood-Org it must match the key binding (or omit header to let the key determine org). Looks like their infra is sending the wrong org.

henry_support: Two remediation paths: 1) reissue a key for acme-corp, or 2) update their header to acme-qa. For the meeting, quickest is a temporary key. I can reissue a trial key for acme-corp and scope-match. Need approval from maria.

maria_sales: Yes please reissue. Also they asked about why it worked earlier — could be env var flip or they shadowed header in staging.

nina_sre: Also watch for project-level binding: if they call with a project header (X-Redwood-Project) that doesn't belong to the org, we also return 403. Ask them to list all outgoing custom headers.

sam_backend: Logging tip: if they enable request_id tracing we can correlate. Ask them to send the response headers we return: we include X-Request-ID and X-Key-Org in the 4xx body for triage.

maria_sales: On it. Sending contact into the meeting now.

henry_support: Reissued key sk_trial_REISSUED -> bound to acme-corp, same scopes. I just DM'd the key to the lead. Please confirm they replace the key and remove any hard-coded X-Redwood-Org header if they want to rely on key binding.

maria_sales: Confirmed with them in meeting — replaced key and validated embeddings call worked. :tada: They still had a stray X-Redwood-Project header set to an old project; removed that too.

sam_backend: Great. Post-mortem items: add a short FAQ for trial teams about org/project headers and a link to the key-inspect endpoint. Could save future swarms.

nina_sre: I'll add a note in docs and a diagnostic snippet:

```bash
# debug snippet for customers
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" 
  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/keys/inspect | jq '.org, .scopes'
```

maria_sales: Perfect. Thanks everyone — closing this thread. :handshake:
